name: application-password-strength
title: Password Strength
description: Password input paired with a segmented strength bar, label, and optional live requirements checklist that update as the user types.
useWhen: Users are creating or changing a password and benefit from immediate feedback on how strong it is.
You want to encourage stronger passwords without hard-blocking submission until requirements are met.
Pairing a visual strength indicator with an explicit checklist of what's missing (length, symbol, number).
avoidWhen: The password policy is a hard minimum only — a single help-text line is simpler than a meter.
You need cryptographically rigorous strength estimation — compute the score with a library like zxcvbn and pass it in; this component only renders the result.
The field is a password confirmation/repeat field — a match indicator is more useful there than a strength meter.
responsiveBehavior: The meter and checklist are a single-column flex stack that inherits the width of its container at all breakpoints.
accessibility: The segmented bar uses role="img" with an aria-label stating the strength in words, since color and fill alone aren't accessible.
The strength label is linked to the input via aria-describedby so it's announced on focus.
Requirement list items pair an icon with visible text so met/unmet state isn't conveyed by color or icon shape alone.

variants.title: Strong password
variants.description: Password field with a fully filled 4-segment strength bar, a 'Strong password' label, and all requirements met.
accessibility: aria-label on the strength bar announces 'Password strength: strong' independent of color.

variants.title: Strong password (Dark)
variants.description: Strong-password strength meter adapted for dark application surfaces.
accessibility: Bar segment and label colors must meet WCAG AA contrast on dark surfaces.

variants.title: Fair password
variants.description: Same component mid-typing: half-filled strength bar, a 'Fair password' label, and one requirement still unmet.
accessibility: Unmet requirements use a distinct outline icon plus muted text, not color alone.

variants.title: Fair password (Dark)
variants.description: Fair-password strength meter state adapted for dark application surfaces.
accessibility: Bar segment and label colors must meet WCAG AA contrast on dark surfaces.
